facts.business: Bandhan Bank is a commercial bank providing retail and wholesale banking services including deposits, advances, and digital banking across India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Key priorities will include strengthening balance sheet resilience, deepening the retail and secured lending franchise, enhancing steady growth of deposits, and accelerating digital transformation initiatives.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Balance sheet resilience, retail and secured lending, deposit growth, digital transformation

key_risks: Technological innovation and evolving customer expectations
Concentration risk in promoter group and related party exposures
facts.related_party_note: The Bank has transactions with related parties including Bandhan Financial Services Limited, Bandhan Financial Holdings Limited, Bandhan Konnagar, Bandhan AMC Limited, Key Management Personnel, and their relatives. Transactions include deposits taken, advances given, interest paid/received, remuneration, rental expense, and dividend paid. Total deposits taken from related parties: ₹561.30 crore; Advances given: ₹8.93 crore; Interest paid: ₹56.25 crore; Remuneration paid: ₹15.37 crore; Rental expense: ₹4.97 crore; Dividend paid: ₹96.62 crore.
